[6:55AM] #Ojo
#IyanaIba
#TrafficUpdate

Vehicular movement from Abule Ado to Iyana Iba through underneath the bridge , Volks and Afolabi Ege  is good. 

There's also good movement from Iyana Iba intersection en route Igando through the First gate ,Iyana school, Obadore bridge, Afolabi, Adeson down to Akesan, while the return journey back to Iyana Iba is also good.

In and out of Igbo Elerin is good for now and Afolabi Ege Flyover to link LASU-Isheri road is also good . 

There's an appreciable movement along Badagry expressway from Iyana Iba inward Agbara through Iyana Isashi ,Iyana Era to Custom check point.
#FollowLASTMA
